n: DM® Essentials 4K60 4:4:4 Transmitter for USB-C® DisplayPort™ Signal (HD-TX-4KZ-111-1G-B)
d: HD-TX-4KZ-111-1G-B DM® Essentials 4K60 4:4:4 Transmitter for USB-C® DisplayPort™ Signal Extension over CATx Cable, Wall Plate, Black

specs.label: Input Signal Type
specs.value: DisplayPort™ over USB-C® (DisplayPort Alt Mode) with HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision®, Deep Color, and 4K60 4:4:4 support

specs.label: Output Signal Type
specs.value: DM Lite® with HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, Deep Color, and 4K60 4:4:4 support

specs.label: Audio digital formats
specs.value: Dolby Digital®, Dolby Digital EX, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby® TrueHD, Dolby Atmos®, DTS®, DTS ES, DTS 96/24, DTS HD® High Res, DTS-HD Master Audio, DTS:X®, LPCM up to 8 channels

specs.label: Power Pack
specs.value: Input: 100-240VAC; Output: 24VDC 0.75A; Model: PW-2407WUL (sold separately, required only if the HD-TX-4KZ-111-1G is used with a wall plate receiver)

specs.label: Composition
specs.value: Metal housing and bracket with black polycarbonate front label overlay

specs.label: Mounting
specs.value: Mounts in a 1-gang (or larger) 2-1/4 inch (57 mm) deep U.S. electrical box or plaster ring (not included)

specs.label: Faceplate
specs.value: Requires a decorator style faceplate; ( FP-G series, sold separately)
